Secrets._comment: Supply the Anthropic key via: dotnet user-secrets set "Umbraco:AI:Secrets:AnthropicApiKey" "sk-ant-..." (run from TestHost dir). In the backoffice Anthropic connection, set ApiKey to the literal: $Umbraco:AI:Secrets:AnthropicApiKey  — NEVER commit a real key here.

TypeSafe._comment: Supply the TypeSafe key via: dotnet user-secrets set "SchemeWeaver:TypeSafe:ApiKey" "..." (run from TestHost dir), or the SchemeWeaver__TypeSafe__ApiKey environment variable. Without a key the satellite boots inert and auto-map falls through to the prior mapper; set Enabled to false to switch it off explicitly. NEVER commit a real key here.
